Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Fixed UI corruption when toggling experimental features repeatedly; fully self-contained build (no .NET install needed); loopback bus level and mute; experimental ON AIR card with per-app loopback list; SYNC RATE and LOW LATENCY toggles matching the stock panel; transient driver sessions so the stock panel works alongside
Program_Info.Program_System_Requirements: Windows 10 1809+, MOTU M2/M4/M6 audio interface, official MOTU driver installed

English.Char_Desc_45: MOTU M-series control panel for Windows
English.Char_Desc_80: Control panel for MOTU M2/M4/M6 interfaces: live meters, loopback monitor
English.Char_Desc_250: Small Windows utility for MOTU M2, M4 and M6 audio interfaces. Live input/output meters, loopback monitor showing what OBS hears, bus level and per-app controls, test tone, buffer size and sample rate control, low-latency mode, editable presets, driver update check.
English.Char_Desc_450: motu-ui is a free, open-source Windows control panel for MOTU M2, M4 and M6 audio interfaces. It shows live input and output level meters plus a loopback monitor that displays exactly what OBS and other recorders hear, puts every driver control (buffer size, sample rate, sample-rate sync, low-latency mode) in one compact window, offers one-click editable presets (e.g. Record at 16 samples vs Stream at 128), and an optional ON AIR card with a loopback bus fader, mute and per-app list. A speaker button plays a test tone to verify the loopback path visually. A built-in checker queries the MOTU download page for your exact model when a newer driver ships.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
motu-ui is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows control panel for MOTU M2, M4 and M6 USB audio interfaces, built for people who record, stream or monitor through their interface every day.
motu-ui puts everything the stock panel has - plus live metering it doesn't - in one compact native window: - Live stereo level meters for IN and OUT with peak hold and clip indication - A third LOOP meter showing the loopback capture endpoint - exactly the signal OBS, Discord and other recorders receive - An optional ON AIR card (experimental) with a loopback bus fader, bus mute and a live list of the apps feeding the bus - A test-tone button that plays a 440 Hz signal through the device so the loopback path can be verified visually - Sample rate (44.1-192 kHz) and host buffer size (16-1024 samples) with a live latency readout - Sync rate and Low Latency toggles, plainly labeled with tooltips - Editable named presets, for example Record: 16 samples + low latency, Stream: 128 samples - A driver update checker that queries the MOTU download page for your specific model
The app wraps the official MSeriesLib.dll that ships with the MOTU driver, so changes are applied by the vendor library and device state is read back after each one. It is a 32-bit process because the MOTU control library is 32-bit; it runs on Windows 10 1809 and later, on x86 and x64 machines. The official MOTU driver must be installed; motu-ui complements it rather than replacing it. Download from the GitHub Releases page.
